probe.title: Helping Brands Thrive With Real-Time Fashion | nitex
probe.text_sample: Helping Brands Thrive With Real-Time Fashion | nitex Meet Nitex Get started We power real-time fashion with exclusive, ready-to-buy designs—helping brands move faster, stay on trend, and grow without compromise. Inside Nitex [01] Our story from vision to global impact Founded with a bold mission to reinvent the fashion supply chain, NITEX has rapidly transformed into a multi-continent powerhouse. Today, our cross-functional teams work seamlessly from Dhaka to London, Barcelona and New York, backed by a network of certified factories in Bangladesh. Through proprietary tech, we deliver creative excellence, speed and transparency—redefining how brands design, sample and ship seasonal collections. INSIDE NITEX [02] What we do The new standard in fashion supply As the design-driven engine for today’s agile brands, NITEX unites trend forecasting, in-house prototyping, fit validation and global delivery into one seamless workflow. We focus on trending design, instead of the trendiest design, to help our brand partners succeed.
